items.text: Round 2 decisions (d1=A, d2=A, d3=B) are now applied to plan.md. d1 (post-scaffold lifecycle verification fallback): Phase I step 5, the Rollout Checklist entry, and §13 Definition of Done all state that the agent attempts `vrooli scenario restart vrooli-emulator`, probes `/health` on success, and on sandbox-blocked runs emits a structured skip note (command attempted + error captured) for the reviewer — build/test passes remain the strongest signal. d2 (CLI approach): §4 Scope bullet and Phase F are rewritten to port `scenarios/scenario-to-desktop/cli/domains/livedesktop/` → `scenarios/vrooli-emulator/cli/domains/sessions/` with `livedesktop` → `session` rename, preserving tested flag parsing and human-readable output formatting, dropping obsolete flags (auto-artifact, `vrooliRoot` lookup), and migrating existing CLI tests. `metrics tail` is a fresh thin HTTP client (no prior equivalent). d3 (test helper visibility): Testing Plan adds an explicit 'Test helpers (visibility)' section stating that helpers inside `api/livedesktop/` and `api/procmetrics/` remain unexported; the acceptance-tests sibling constructs its own harness against the public HTTP surface. The out-of-scope list now includes 'Exported test harness for cross-package consumers'.

All five readiness dimensions are at 3. The plan meets the full bar for queueing: problem is fully understood, acceptance_allow covers `scenarios/vrooli-emulator/**` and aligns with the plan's file-level changes, the phased strategy (A-I) is concrete with file/line references, the testing plan specifies fake-backend isolation and t.Setenv-driven headless degradation so no real X11 binaries are required, and the risk table covers the load-bearing failure modes with mitigations.

Phase 1 hard-cut coordination reminder: this item only creates `scenarios/vrooli-emulator/`. The companion `chore/scenario-to-desktop-remove-livedesktop` and `execute/emulator-acceptance-tests-phase-1` must land in the same release window to complete the initiative's Phase 1 bundle. Initiative rollup currently shows 1/13 complete (the research item); this item is 1 of the 12 pending. Queue sequencing matters but is enforced by the initiative-level batch-queue, not by this item's plan.

No new decisions were surfaced during finalization. Remaining unknowns (e.g., whether the sandbox will permit `vrooli scenario restart`) are execution-time environment conditions, not planning gaps — they are handled by the structured skip-note fallback written into the plan.

plan_updates: Finalize pass applied three incorporations: (1) §4 Scope and Phase F rewritten to reflect d2 — CLI is ported from `scenarios/scenario-to-desktop/cli/domains/livedesktop/` with `livedesktop` → `session` rename, obsolete flags dropped, tested flag parsing and output formatting preserved; `metrics tail` remains a fresh thin HTTP client; existing CLI tests migrate with rename. (2) Testing Plan gains a new 'Test helpers (visibility)' subsection reflecting d3 — all test helpers stay unexported (package-private); sibling acceptance-tests item builds its own public-surface harness; 'Exported test harness for cross-package consumers' added to out-of-scope. (3) Phase I step 5, Rollout Checklist, and §13 Definition of Done tightened to reflect d1 — agent attempts `vrooli scenario restart vrooli-emulator` + `/health` probe; on sandbox-blocked runs emits a structured skip note with command + error for reviewer; environment-only failures do NOT fail the item. No new 'TBD' sections introduced; plan is internally consistent.
